meaning:
A man of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.14;
father of: Menahem (H4505)
§ Gadi = "my fortune"
the Gadite father of Menahem, a king of Israel

elsewhere.note: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.
